label: sec:ch4-computation-intro
html: Methane raises the coordination number from two to four. Methane CH_4 as a molecular braid joins a central carbon to four hydrogens by four shared trefoils on the molecular strand set. Among all ways of arranging the four bond strands, the LP cost is minimised by the S_4-symmetric strand orderings. We read this S_4 symmetry as the 109.5^\circ tetrahedral bond angle. The same \Phi_1 minimisation that produced linear CO_2 now selects the tetrahedral geometry of CH_4.
